title: KV cache quantization: INT8 vs FP8 calibration and accuracy validation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Determine whether INT8 or FP8 quantization for the KV cache provides the best trade-off between latency, memory, and generation quality on production LLMs (e.g., Llama-2-13B, Mixtral-8x). Background: Previous runs (ENG-6124, ENG-7341) evaluated KV quantization across kernels but lacked a consistent calibration pipeline and per-token quality regression thresholds. This ticket establishes a calibration workflow, evaluation harness, and decision criteria for rolling a KV quant profile into runtime. Acceptance criteria: 1) Calibration procedure documented and reproducible; 2) Measured latency and p50/p95 token-generation slowdown for both INT8 and FP8 on representative sequence length distributions; 3) Quality regressions measured across 3 eval suites with <1% degradation on high-sensitivity prompts or identified root cause and mitigations; 4) Clear rollout recommendation (FP8/INT8 or hybrid) and fallback policy.
experiment_plan: 1) Build deterministic calibration job: collect 50k KV cache activations across tokens for targeted models and sequence buckets. 2) Produce per-layer calibration stats and candidate scales for symmetric/asymmetric quantization for INT8 and FP8 exponent biasing. 3) Run inference harness on dev cluster nodes (A100-80GB and H100-80GB) measuring end-to-end latency, per-token latency, and memory. 4) Run accuracy evaluation: perplexity delta, response-similarity (BERTScore), and safety prompt checks across eval sets: 'web-qc', 'summaries-regen', 'dialogue-long-context'. 5) Stress test with burst traffic patterns to see caching behavior under high concurrency. 6) Document kernel fallbacks and pointers to runtime config flags.
datasets: web-qc (5k prompts), summaries-regen (2k prompts), dialogue-long-context (1k sessions, average 1.2k tokens), calibration corpus (50k KV samples sampled from production traces, scrubbed), synthetic edge cases (numerics, long repeating context).
metrics: latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, tokens_per_sec, memory_delta_mb, perplexity_delta_pct, bertscore_delta_pct, safety_regressions_count, tail_latency_incidents
updates: 2026-02-20: Ticket created. Initial owner: Daniel Kim. Linked ENG-6124 and ENG-7341 for context.
2026-02-25: Calibrator prototype implemented in runtime/calib_v2; collected 12k KV samples for Llama-2-13B from dev traffic. Noted wide per-layer variance in dynamic range for attention keys.
2026-03-01: Baseline (FP16 KV) p50 token latency on A100: 7.8ms; p95: 16.2ms. INT8 prototype reduced memory by ~35% but increased p50 by +8% and p95 by +12% without per-layer bias correction.
2026-03-04: FP8 prototype (E4M3 variant) yielded memory reduction ~20% and p50 change +2%, p95 +4%. However observed quality regression on numeric-heavy prompts (BERTScore -1.9%).
2026-03-07: Added per-layer scale calibration and symmetric/asymmetric selection logic. INT8 with per-layer asymmetric scales closed quality gap; numeric prompt regression reduced to -0.4%.

2026-03-10: End-to-end harness run on H100: INT8 (with calibrated asymmetric) p50 8.4ms (+7.7% from FP16), FP8 p50 7.9ms (+1.3%). Token throughput at 32 concurrent streams: INT8 12.1k tps, FP8 13.8k tps, FP16 14.2k tps.

2026-03-12: QA review: flagged safety regression cluster for FP8 on 'dialogue-long-context' where hallucination rate increased by 0.8% absolute. PM asked for targeted error analysis and mitigation plan.

2026-03-14: Calibration pipeline stabilized; CI jobs added for calibration reproducibility and sample retention policy. Preparing PR for runtime-1.20 to expose 'kv_quant_profile' with 'int8_calibrated' and 'fp8_e4m3' options.
decision: Interim: ship calibrated INT8 as opt-in experimental profile for non-sensitive workloads; keep FP8 in canary for throughput-sensitive workloads but block for long-context dialogue by default until targeted mitigations reduce hallucination regressions. Final rollout to be decided after a 2-week canary with real traffic.
next_steps: 1) Merge PR to expose kv_quant_profile flags behind feature gate. 2) Run 2-week canary on low-risk customer subset with telemetry to capture safety signals. 3) Create automatic rollback triggers in Console if safety_regressions_count > 5 in 24h or p95 latency increases >15%. 4) Investigate hybrid scheme: FP8 for attention values, INT8 for keys/queries, and hardware-specific microkernels for H100.
risks: FP8 numeric instability on long-context numeric reasoning; increased tail latency for INT8 on some kernel paths; calibration sample bias if calibration corpus not representative of production.
approval: Eng Lead: Priya Nair (approved 2026-03-14); PM Review: Marco Li (requested more QA instrumentation); Security: N/A
